name: Game XP
blurb: Gaming arena at the Rock in Rio festival in Rio de Janeiro, combining esports, cosplay and game-industry panels during Rock in Rio week.
notes: On hiatus / tied to a festival with no near-term edition. Game XP is a gaming side-event run inside Rock in Rio's Cidade do Rock, not a standalone annual convention, and Rock in Rio itself is non-annual: Rock in Rio 2026 ran Sept 4-13, 2026 (already finished before today, 2026-10-05) and no Rock in Rio 2027 is planned -- coverage (Billboard Brasil, Exame, RioTur) indicates the next edition is expected in 2028. The given url (gamexp.com.br) no longer hosts a Game XP site at all: it now 301-redirects to omelete.com.br's general entertainment homepage, with no Game XP content, dates or guests anywhere on it, so no official page, cover image or guest list could be captured. No evidence was found that a Game XP edition ran during RiR 2026 either. Will need re-checking once/if Rock in Rio announces its next (2028-ish) edition.
